statements.t: We are also accelerating patient enrollment in the planned Phase 2a trial of GX-03 for hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) which is now expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027, ahead of the previously announced second-quarter target.
With HS enrollment beginning and our Phase 2b atopic dermatitis trial moving forward, we expect the first quarter of 2027 to be a very active time for Turn.
